main.description: A media item's membership on a list, embedding the media's display metadata.

listUri.description: Reference (AT-URI) to the list this item belongs to.

mainCredit.description: Primary credited person for the media (e.g. book author, film director).

mainCreditRole.description: Role of the main credit (e.g. author, director, host).

creativeWorkType.description: Type of media: book, movie, tv, podcast, article, game, music, course, video, etc.

genres.description: Genres associated with the media item.

listType.description: Denormalized copy of the parent list's listType at the time this item was added.

posterUrl.description: URL of the media item's poster/cover image.

backdropUrl.description: URL of the media item's backdrop image.

releaseDate.description: Release date of the media item.

bookProgress.description: Optional embedded reading/watch progress for this item.

mediaItemId.description: Reference to media_items table for aggregated data. (Collective Social extension field, not part of the base popfeed schema.)

order.description: Display order within the list. Higher numbers appear first (top). 0 appears at bottom. (Collective Social extension field, not part of the base popfeed schema.)

userItem.description: Reference (AT-URI) to the user's app.collectivesocial.feed.useritem record for this media item. (Collective Social extension field.)

addedAt.description: Timestamp when this item was added to the list.
